records.title: ci(routed-rust): bound PR evidence with job and command deadlines
records.release_claim: required routed jobs and long-running evidence commands have explicit, per-owner deadlines and malformed overrides fail closed
records.reason: A hung PR-evidence or review command can otherwise block candidate qualification indefinitely. The workflow checker pins each named job instead of trusting a global timeout count.
records.non_claim: Deadlines do not make a timed-out analysis complete, clean, or advisory by default.

records.title: chore(deps): bump anyhow 1.0.102 to 1.0.104 for RUSTSEC-2026-0190
records.release_claim: the selected Rust dependency graph excludes the affected anyhow unsoundness versions
records.reason: The exact candidate must not retain a dependency version with a published unsoundness advisory when the compatible patched release is already integrated and cargo-deny accepts it.
records.non_claim: The dependency update does not change RIPR's analyzer or evidence semantics.

records.title: docs(learnings): gate-table drift, advisory database movement, byte-exact validation, and squash-merge ancestry
records.reason: These dated lessons are valuable retained history, but the required CI, receipt-validation, dependency, and promotion behaviors are independently represented by their implementation and normative records.
records.non_claim: Deferral does not erase or weaken the corresponding code and policy fixes.

records.title: ci(routed-rust): run the full precommit gate table in every required lane
records.release_claim: every required Rust and docs lane invokes the single shared precommit gate table, with lane-only gates added separately and mechanically checked
records.reason: Three same-day main breaks came from required lanes omitting gates that precommit already owned. The selected candidate needs a trustworthy qualification path even though the workflow composition is not runtime product semantics.
records.non_claim: The change does not alter branch protection, analyzer behavior, or any gate's semantic policy.

records.title: fix(domain): move the serde wire-casing test out of domain
records.release_claim: none; preserves the wire-casing pin while restoring the domain-layer no-rendering dependency rule
records.reason: #2250 placed a serde_json assertion in the domain test module and left architecture/precommit red. Moving the same test to the application artifact layer repairs ownership without changing the serialized vocabulary.
records.non_claim: The relocation does not alter CheckArtifactV1, language enums, or public wire casing.
